gate0_pit.note: Naming mismatch: variant labeled 'ICWeight' but actual weight_method='ivol' (inverse volatility). Not a PIT issue but a documentation inaccuracy.

gate1_performance.assessment: BELOW TARGET — SR 0.826 < 2.0, CAGR 12.07% < 16%, MDD 37.77% > 25%. All three primary targets missed. Calmar 0.319 is weak. Worse than base STR_1333 (SR 0.857, CAGR 13.43%, MDD 34.31%) on all metrics — ivol weighting degraded performance.

gate2_artifacts.note: No separate analysis_*.csv files for variant (only in parent output).

gate3_role_honesty.assessment: BM_Corr 0.65 is moderate — consistent with diversifier role. Not core_alpha (would need higher SR/CAGR), not pure defense (would need lower BM_Corr). Role declaration honest.

gate4_statistical.assessment: OOS retention 45.2% is marginal (IS SR 1.073 vs OOS SR 0.485). Alpha trend slightly decaying (recent/full = 0.94). IC stability not available for variant. Parent IC stability shows decay (full IC 0.0315 / recent 3Y IC 0.0162 = 0.52). DSR not computed.

gate5_ff5.assessment: Using parent STR_1333 FF5 results (variant shares same factor construction). FF5 alpha 5.7% annualized with t=1.415 — positive but not significant at 5% level. FF3 alpha t=1.15, Carhart4 t=1.17 — all below 1.96. FMB Score lambda t=2.05 is significant. Alpha exists but lacks statistical power for standalone significance.
gate5_ff5.note: FF5 analysis from parent base strategy; variant-specific FF5 not available.

strengths: PIT fully clean — no lookahead violations across C1-C15
Solid academic foundation (BM + ESBR synergy, Asness/Novy-Marx/Piotroski)
Rolling 3Y positive ratio 86.6% — consistent alpha generation
weaknesses: MDD 37.77% far exceeds 25% target — worst among all metrics
OOS retention only 45.2% — significant IS/OOS gap
Worse than base STR_1333 on ALL metrics — ivol weighting did NOT help
FF5 alpha t-stats all below significance threshold (max 1.415)
Naming mismatch: labeled ICWeight but uses ivol
recommendation: KEEP as Grade B diversifier. Not promotion-worthy. The ivol weighting experiment failed to improve on the EW base — all metrics degraded. The alpha source (BM+ESBR synergy) is real but modest. For future S5 mutations: (1) fix variant naming (ivol != IC-weighted), (2) try true IC-weighted allocation if IC data available, (3) focus on MDD reduction which is the binding constraint.
